item.subject: science
item.stem:
Priya wants to measure her body temperature with a digital clinical thermometer at home in Jaipur.
Which set of steps is correct and safe?

options.A: Place the thermometer under her tongue, take the reading as soon as any number appears on the display, and wash the tip only if it looks dirty.
options.B: Reset the thermometer, wash the tip before use, place it under her tongue, wait for the beep, read the temperature, and wash the tip again after use.
options.C: Wash the tip, place the thermometer anywhere on the body such as the wrist, and read the number immediately after switching it on.
options.D: Reset the thermometer, place it under her tongue with her mouth open, and wash the whole thermometer including the digital display in water.
